args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18) after the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; on-call was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
